purpose: Defines what an implementation plan must hold: tasks, dependencies, deterministic next-task selection, traceability, task granularity, document paths, transience, and task groups.
summary: Overview: plan created by start-plan and consumed by start-implement; JSON format; scope of the target system
FNC-001: tasks have unique identifiers, priorities, and dependencies
FNC-002: next executable task is uniquely determined; progress states including implemented and failed
FNC-003: traceability among requirements, designs, and tasks, with detection of missing tasks
FNC-004: task granularity executable by a single executor agent
FNC-005: each task holds paths of documents needed for implementation
FNC-006: plan is a transient working file that may be discarded
FNC-007: plan holds no differential feature identifier
FNC-008: task groups as units of selection, build check, and review
tasks: Creating an implementation plan with start-plan
Checking traceability of requirements to tasks
title: REQ-024 実装計画書 要件定義書
